picks.episode_title: NBA Opening Night Preview & Picks | Tue Oct 20
picks.quote: First three star bet of the season is going to be a player prop on Chet Holmgren. Under 13 and a half points for Chet.
picks.reason: Chet Holmgren is expected to have limited minutes due to injury, making the under on his points a strong play.
picks.edge: Chet is injured and likely on a minutes limit after not playing in preseason.
